item: NBA.com Terms of Use §1 — Ownership and Use Restrictions
published_value: Basketball Content may not be reproduced, reused, linked to or otherwise used without the Operator's written permission.
official_value: "No Basketball Content from the Services may be reproduced, republished, uploaded, posted, modified, reused, transmitted, reproduced, distributed, copied, publicly displayed, linked to, or otherwise used except as provided in these Terms of Use without the written permission of the Operator."
note: Quoted verbatim from the section read this session.

published_value: Word links from non-commercial sites are permitted to NBA home pages only; links to internal pages are not permitted without permission.
official_value: "All links to Services from a Permissible Site must be to the Services' home page or to the homepage of a particular team – links to internal pages within the Services (e.g., a player page, a photo gallery, or a feature article) other than to the home page of a League's team are not permitted."
note: Material for this site, which cites internal game/schedule pages as sources. Not resolved; flagged (V-F1).

item: NBA.com Terms of Use §9 — NBA Statistics
published_value: NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with any gambling activity, including legal gambling activity.
official_value: "(iv) the NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with any gambling activity (including legal gambling activity)"
note: Also §9(vii) restricts comprehensive, regularly updated statistics databases without prior consent.

published_value: NBA statistics are not available for bulk download, academic or personal.
official_value: "Our stats are not available for download for either academic or personal use. They are for viewing and enjoying on NBA.com/Stats"
note: Basis for the fail-closed data contract: no bulk statistics feed is used.

item: NBA official release, 26 Oct 2026 — prediction-market integrity framework
published_value: Framework with Kalshi and Polymarket; DraftKings expanded to prediction markets; authorized operators follow market restrictions aligned with the NBA's latest sports betting restrictions.
official_value: "the designation of Kalshi and Polymarket as the league's Preferred Prediction Market Exchanges"; "All Authorized Prediction Market Operator partnerships will include enhanced integrity obligations specific to prediction markets and market restrictions aligned with the NBA's latest sports betting restrictions."
note: The release does NOT enumerate the specific restrictions, so the press-reported prop/parlay bans stay unverified (see Unverified page).

item: 국민체육진흥법 — statute identity and effective dates
published_value: National Sports Promotion Act, Act No. 21742 (partially amended 2 Jun 2026), in force 3 Sep 2026.
official_value: "국민체육진흥법 [시행 2026. 9. 3.] [법률 제21742호, 2026. 6. 2., 일부개정]"; the Article 26 view shows "[시행 2026. 6. 2.] [법률 제21742호, 2026. 6. 2., 일부개정]"
note: IRREGULARITY: the whole-law page and the Article 26 view show different effective dates (2026-09-03 vs 2026-06-02). Recorded, not resolved (V-F2).

item: 국민체육진흥법 제26조 제1항 — prohibition of similar betting schemes
published_value: Only the Seoul Olympic Sports Promotion Foundation and its delegated operator may issue sports promotion voting tickets or similar instruments for reward.
official_value: 제26조(유사행위의 금지 등) ① 서울올림픽기념국민체육진흥공단과 수탁사업자가 아닌 자는 체육진흥투표권 또는 이와 비슷한 것을 발행(정보통신망에 의한 발행을 포함한다)하여 결과를 적중시킨 자에게 재물이나 재산상의 이익을 제공하는 행위(이하 "유사행위"라 한다)를 하여서는 아니 된다.
note: English text is a compiler translation; the Korean text is authoritative.

item: 국민체육진흥법 제26조 제2항 제1호 — systems for similar betting
published_value: No one may design, produce, distribute or publicly provide a system for issuing such tickets over an information network.
official_value: ② 누구든지 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 행위를 하여서는 아니 된다. 1. 「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」제2조제1항제1호에 따른 정보통신망을 이용하여 체육진흥투표권이나 이와 비슷한 것을 발행하는 시스템을 설계ㆍ제작ㆍ유통 또는 공중이 이용할 수 있도록 제공하는 행위
note: Directly relevant to any line-origination product offered to users in Korea. Legal review required; not a legal conclusion.

item: 국민체육진흥법 제26조 제2항 제2호 — providing match information for similar betting
published_value: No one may provide information about the relevant sporting event for the purpose of such similar betting.
official_value: 2. 유사행위를 위하여 해당 운동경기 관련 정보를 제공하는 행위
note: This is why the site publishes research and no picks/wagering product; counsel to confirm scope.
